targetTests.title: inserts byte-preserving media with explicit geometry %j
covers a square with portrait pixels %i by %i

rows.disposition: Original landscape 4x2 media into a square produces horizontal paired crop .25. Original portrait 2x4 and 4x6 media into a 120x120 square produce vertical paired crop .25 and .16667 respectively. Independent XML attributes and byte preservation assertions cover both source aspect branches using original assets and values. Exact-aspect and near-zero-visible rounding are separately asserted. This adapts cover arithmetic only; placeholder insertion, identity replacement and return-object invalidation remain explicit model obligations.
